definition: to discover that something is there
description: A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.

de.answer: Sie nimmt einen Diamanten aus einem Kästchen.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está sacando un diamante de una caja.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle sort un diamant d'une boîte.
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
